''See also: [[Benji Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Benji, formerly known as Jeralt Herris, is a [[Vandenyan family|Vandenyan]] man of significant stature, standing nearly seven feet tall with caramel-colored skin and a missing ear. He was originally the child of a musician and a banker from the Capital, but he was later abducted by a revolutionary named [[Rudeus Maxwell]]. During his childhood, Benji was trained alongside other kidnapped children to become an [[assassin]]. Following this period of training, he was eventually released and became part of a group of killers who claimed credit for the death of a [[Regent]]. In more recent events, Benji has been associated with the [[Gardeners]] and is still learning the protocols of the [[Guild]]. He possesses the ability to hover in midair while surrounded by a cloud of purple-light butterflies and utilizes specialized [[shears]] that transform into sickle-like shapes during use.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Benji is a man who floats within a cloud of purple-light butterflies. He currently resides in a cell.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a newly minted [[Gardener]], he is motivated by the desire to become [[Soulbound]]. He is an [[assassin]] who underwent training under [[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Benji was trained by [[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]] to become an [[assassin]] and a pseudo-[[Gardener]]. He is identified as one of the false [[Gardeners]] belonging to [[Shera]]. Additionally, he carries a pair of [[shears]] that must belong to [[Lucan]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Benji is a Reader who has successfully completed the [[Awakening]] process. He also carries a pair of [[shears]] that must belong to [[Lucan]].}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As one of [[Shera]]'s false [[Gardeners]], Benji is a pseudo-[[Gardener]] who underwent training under [[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]]. He carries a pair of [[shears]] that are required to be [[Lucan]]'s. Having completed the [[Awakening]] process as a Reader, Benji is a newly minted [[Gardener]] with the ambition to become [[Soulbound]]. During his journey, he is seen floating within a cloud of purple-light butterflies.}}
